newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bancomer up sharply on hotel sale.
newsitem.headline: Bancomer up sharply on hotel sale.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican financial group Grupo Financiero Bancomer SA de CV were up sharply in early trade on the Mexican bourse on Tuesday on news it had sold three luxury resorts, analysts said.
Bancomer A shares were up 18 centavos to 3.60 pesos and were the most active shares on the bourse, accounting for one-quarter of all shares traded in early dealing.
"They will get substantial revenues from the sale of the group's hotels and we await a heavy impact on the share price," said Nuno Fernandez, an analysts at the ING-Barings brokerage.

Starwood Lodging Trust and Starwood Lodging Corp announced in early trade they had entered a definitive agreement to buy a portfolio of three luxury resorts in Mexico from the banking arm of the Bancomer group for about $133 million.
